web.description:
# Pixelmatch Demo
An interactive demo for [Pixelmatch](https://github.com/mapbox/pixelmatch), a simple and fast JavaScript library for image comparison with perceptual color metrics and [anti-aliasing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spatial_anti-aliasing) detection.
